phase_prompt.summary: The Holy One in their primary state of administrative repose, observing the simulation.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic close-up of the Holy One, a humanoid entity made of dark, polished system materials. The skin is matte black obsidian, flawless and unyielding. The eyes are glowing pools of white plasma, casting a soft, interrogative light on the surroundings. The figure wears robes that look like cascading fiber optic wires, dimly lit. The background is a dark, abstract void of the simulation's upper storage layer. The lighting is moody, highlighting the texture of the artificial skin and the intricate weave of the robes. Cinematic composition, slow-burn drama aesthetic, 8k, highly detailed.
